audit.whatIsWrong: Level 6 row said Mel on both layers while the why-text said Infinite Duress kills the dashless mage.
audit.why: Warwick R is a 1.5s point-and-click suppression on a target with no dash; packet levelChart also shows Warwick at 6.
audit.corrected: phases[4].side and win[4] both set to Warwick (matched pair).

audit.whatIsWrong: Spike text credited Mel with a heal ('Rejuvenating Wave') she does not have.
audit.why: Mel's W is Rebuttal: a barrier that reflects projectiles, negates damage and grants move speed. No heal in her kit.
audit.corrected: Spike now names Rebuttal (W) and its damage negation; the Level 6 spike is keyed to Solar Snare's 11/10.5/10/9.5/9s cooldown.

audit.whatIsWrong: Text said 'reflect with Overwhelm (R)' and referred to Mel's dash.
audit.why: Overwhelm is her passive stack; Golden Eclipse (R) detonates it globally. Reflection is Rebuttal (W). Mel has no dash. Solar Snare's root is the decisive interaction: a root stops Jaws of the Beast's lunge and Infinite Duress' leap.
audit.corrected: Named Rebuttal for the barrier, Golden Eclipse for the global detonate, and made root-denies-lunge-and-leap the spine of the early text — matching the mirror audit.

edits.before: Infinite Duress is a point-and-click fight starter that locks his carry tool. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Mel's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Infinite Duress suppresses for 1.5s and Mel has no dash to answer it. Golden Eclipse hits from anywhere, so kill her before Overwhelm stacks.

edits.before: Mel is a squishy ranged mage who leans on Radiant Volley (Q) poke and Rejuvenating Wave heal; your Eternal Hunger sustain out-heals her chip, and once you W-empower and close with Jaws she has no dash to escape your all-in.
edits.after: Mel is a squishy ranged mage who leans on Radiant Volley (Q) poke and Rebuttal (W), a barrier that negates damage; your Eternal Hunger sustain out-heals her chip, and once Blood Hunt speeds you in she has no dash to escape.

edits.before: Infinite Duress locks Mel down before she can Solar Snare (E) root you or reflect with Overwhelm (R); suppress her the instant she's in range and the squishy mage simply dies.
edits.after: Infinite Duress locks Mel down, but Solar Snare (E) roots on a 9-11s cooldown and a root kills the leap mid-flight — bait it, then suppress her and the squishy mage simply dies.

edits.before: Reflect your burst with Overwhelm if you dump damage
edits.after: Reflect your burst with Rebuttal if you dump damage

edits.before: Even into items you stay ahead: Mel is a squishy poke mage with one root for peel, and a single R connect ends her before her Overwhelm reflect matters.
edits.after: Even into items you stay ahead: Mel is a squishy poke mage whose only peel is Solar Snare, and one R connect ends her before Golden Eclipse detonates Overwhelm.

edits.before: Q-bite Mel as he steps up (hold Q to follow his dash), weave autos, and let the passive out-heal his return damage.
edits.after: Q-bite Mel as she steps up — she has no dash to escape — weave autos, and let Eternal Hunger out-heal her return damage.

edits.before: Q-bite Mel as he steps up (hold Q to follow his dash), weave autos, and let the passive out-heal his return damage.
edits.after: Q-bite Mel as she steps up — she has no dash to escape — weave autos, and let Eternal Hunger out-heal her return damage.

edits.before: Trading into his full burst window with E down — fear is your trade-flipper; without it you are just a sustain bot.
edits.after: Trading after Solar Snare lands with Primal Howl down — its 15s fear is your trade-flipper; without it you are just a sustain bot.
